title: Argentina
goal: Read how Argentina's 1976 coup and its "National Reorganization Process" promised order and modernization, but ended in debt, deindustrialization, and a lost war that forced the return to elections in 1983.

items: State when the 1976 coup happened and who it overthrew.
Explain what Martínez de Hoz's economic policies produced.
Explain why Argentina invaded the Falklands/Malvinas in 1982.
Describe how the war led to the junta's fall.
Use no obstante as a formal alternative to sin embargo.
